blurb: Guests skydive from 14,000 or 18,000 feet, experiencing freefall and parachute ride with the option to take controls. Video packages include instructor wrist cam, extra flyer perspective, and gold deluxe combining multiple video angles. Birthday and group deals are available, and a sister company offers powered hang glider flights.
extraNote: Deposit required to book; fully refundable up to 48 hours before scheduled time · Deposit non-refundable if no show or booking made less than 48 hours before experience · Reservations can be changed up to 5pm the day before booked date, subject to availability and price difference · Weather dependent; delays or reschedules possible with deposit transferred to new date
